action.prompt: This fires after each leaf task. After it completes, check .kiro/specs/<spec>/tasks.md: if every sub-task under the just-completed task's parent (e.g. all T3.x under T3) is now ticked [x], append ONE entry for the parent task to docs/KIRO_JOURNAL.md; otherwise do nothing. Get the date by running `date +%F` (never guess). Start the appended text with a blank line. Entry: date, spec + parent task, Kiro features used, what Kiro got right, what was corrected, anything surprising. Max 8 lines.
